name: Samegawa (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Samegawa village emblem in white: a ring beneath a crown-like device with a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Samegawa, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Samegawa village emblem — a ring beneath a crown-like device with a pointed top
